newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane extends gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane extends gains in late trade.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices extended their gains in late trade on Friday amid last minute deals before the weekend and strong NYMEX futures, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane rose one cent to between 51.75 cents and 52.00 cents a gallon after gaining a quarter cent midday.
Conway, Kansas, hub material in the Midwest rose a half cent to 52.00/52.50 cents after gaining a quarter cent in earlier activity.
Players said the market was helped up by NYMEX December crude oil futures, which ended up 85 cents at $23.59. December propane futures also ended higher, up 1.50 cents.
Meanwhile, earlier Friday a judge ruled Clark Refining and Marketing can restart idled units at its Chicago-area refinery. State regulators had shut the plant on fears it was unsafe.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
